description: A new tool on Toolaby (Test): one more thing the workspace sells. Its Free plan holds everything until access is set. Then wire an extension to it: `npx -y toolaby@latest wire <id>` in an existing extension's folder, `npx -y toolaby@latest create <id>` for a new one.

id.description: Optional: the id within the workspace. Default: from the name.

tagline.description: Optional: one line under the name on the checkout page.

workspace.description: The workspace slug, when you have more than one (toolaby_whoami lists them).

name: toolaby_create_tool
title: Create a tool
